title: Monroe to conduct emergency water main repair affecting several neighborhoods
text:
Government
Monroe to conduct emergency water main repair affecting several neighborhoods
The City of Monroe will begin emergency repairs on a major water main November 5. Several neighborhoods may experience reduced or no water pressure. A precautionary boil water notice will be issued for affected customers.
The City of Monroe announced on Nov. 4 that it will begin an emergency repair of an 8-inch water main on Thursday, November 5, at 10 p.m. The work is expected to last several hours and may impact water service in multiple areas.
According to the announcement, residents and businesses in the North Forsythe Bypass, Highway 165 North at the Finks Hideaway intersection, The Reserve on Bayou DeSiard apartments, Northeast Louisiana Veterans Home, areas along Victory Boulevard, Allgood Street and Florio Court, and the Egrets Landing neighborhood may experience low to no water pressure during the repair.
A precautionary boil water notice will be issued for all affected customers. This notice will remain in effect until required water quality testing is completed and results are received.
Residents with questions about the repair or their service can contact the Water Distribution Office at (318) 329-2811 or Toby Price at (318) 372-1789.
The City expressed appreciation for the public’s patience during this necessary maintenance.
